metadata.title: PSComData
metadata.description: PowerShell Module to connect to BP Fuel Card system via iConnectData ComData System

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Get-ComDataDriverList' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
